operators.name: abs_relu6_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise abs(input) then ReLU6 on the result.
Output[i] = min(max(abs(input[i]), 0.0), 6.0) for all elements in input order.
Matches reference step x = torch.abs(x) followed by x = nn.ReLU6()(x).
Elementwise absolute value of input tensor x.
Input shape [256,1024,1024], dtype float32, device cuda.
Output shape identical, device cuda, dtype float32.
Input is the result of step_001, same shape/dtype/device.
Output shape identical, device cuda, dtype float32.
Returns the final tensor from step_002.
